sources.excerpt: The Men's road race of the 2026 UCI Road World Championships was a cycling event that took place on 27 September 2026 in Montreal, Canada.

The race was won by United States rider Brandon McNulty, beating Australian rider Michael Matthews and Dutch rider Mathieu van der Poel by 13 seconds after escaping with around 30 kilometres (19 mi) remaining.
The circuit was 13.4 kilometres (8.3 mi) in length around Mount Royal, with 269 metres (883 ft) of elevation gain per lap. The circuit would be tackled 12 times.
Swiss voters reject an initiative that proposed to enshrine a stricter form of Swiss neutrality, which would have prevented Switzerland from imposing economic sanctions and cooperating with NATO.
The government has decided to put two proposals to a public vote on 27 September 2026:
Popular initiative ‘For safe food – through strengthening sustainable domestic production, increasing plant-based foods and ensuring clean drinking water (food initiative)’.
Both referendums were rejected by a wide margin.
Starship flight 14 was the fourteenth launch and the first operational flight of the SpaceX Starship launch system.

Ship 41 performed an orbital-insertion burn, placing Starship into a sustained orbit for the first time. The spacecraft then deployed 26 operational Starlink V3 satellites as Starlink Group 31-1, marking Starship's first deployment of operational payloads.

After approximately two hours in orbit, the mission profile was shortened to have an early splashdown. Initially, SpaceX mission planners intended for the ship to spend around eight hours in space, but this was shortened significantly to two hours.
